## Discovery & Translational Science

- **Deubiquitinase-targeting chimeras highlighted as novel modality for protein stabilization** — *PubMed* [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42586475/)
  - Deubiquitinase-targeting chimeras (DUBTACs) are reviewed as an emerging therapeutic platform designed to selectively recruit deubiquitinases to target proteins, reversing degradation and restoring protein function.

- **Neuron-derived EV miR-151a-5p mediates antidepressant response and demonstrates rapid efficacy** — *medRxiv* [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.11.26360193)
  - Analysis of SNAP25-tagged neuron-derived extracellular vesicles (NEVs) isolated from patient plasma identified microRNA miR-151a-5p as selectively elevated in antidepressant responders and deficient in post-mortem depressed brain tissue.
  - Engineered miR-151a-5p-loaded NEVs administered in mouse models delivered cargo to neurons, regulated synaptic network genes including RIMS3 and ELAVL3, and induced rapid antidepressant-like behavioral responses.

- **Structural insights into HACD-TECR fatty acid elongation complex reveal potential colorectal cancer target** — *PubMed* [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42585309/)
  - Elucidation of the molecular structure of the HACD-TECR complex, which drives very-long-chain fatty acid elongation, identifies specific structural mechanisms that present a novel therapeutic target in colorectal cancer.

- **Modulating sleep pathways emerges as direct strategy for chronic disease management** — *Nature Medicine* [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04582-5)
  - Research highlights a transition treating sleep disruption not merely as a secondary symptom, but as a direct therapeutic entry point to modify underlying disease biology across chronic pain, depression, and metabolic disorders.

- **Hesperetin targets Hmgcs2-Pparα-Cisd2 axis to delay hepatic aging** — *npj Aging* [npj Aging](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41514-026-00479-2)
  - Preclinical data demonstrate that the natural compound hesperetin activates the Hmgcs2-Pparα-Cisd2 signaling cascade, attenuating age-related hepatic structural and functional decline.

- **Industry report details next-generation ADC engineering trends** — *Andrew Pannu / X* [Andrew Pannu / X](https://x.com/andrewpannu/status/2087544646016573495)
  - Industry landscape analysis profiling over 2,000 antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) programs and ~400 deals highlights a transition away from first-generation construct limits, such as narrow therapeutic windows and topoisomerase 1 target resistance.
  - R&D investment is increasingly targeting novel payload mechanisms, bispecific and dual-payload constructs, and site-specific linker engineering to enable higher dosing and broader combination strategies.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

- **[Biotech]** **Ivonescimab plus chemotherapy demonstrates high activity in Phase 2 triple-negative breast cancer study** — *Nature Medicine* [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04564-7)
  - A multicenter Phase 2 trial evaluated the PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy in first-line locally advanced unresectable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC).
  - The combination produced encouraging preliminary objective response rates, supporting advancement into a pivotal Phase 3 study.

- **[Biotech]** **Silence Therapeutics reports positive Phase 2 data for divesiran in polycythemia vera** — *BioPharma Dive* [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/silence-divesiran-vaccines-itm-crl-abcellera-biomarin/827400/)
  - Nucleic acid-based therapy divesiran demonstrated a 69% placebo-adjusted response rate in patients with polycythemia vera during Phase 2 testing.
  - The therapy showed a clean safety profile with two mild cases of anemia, positioning the program to compete against Takeda and Protagonist's rusfertide.

- **[Biotech]** **NeOnc Technologies reports positive Phase 2a results for intranasal NEO100 in glioma** — *BioStocks / X* [BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2087509918647513354)
  - Phase 2a trial evaluating intranasal NEO100 in recurrent IDH1-mutant high-grade glioma met its primary endpoint.
  - Treatment demonstrated a 6-month progression-free survival (PFS) rate of 48.9%, compared to a pre-specified standard-of-care benchmark of 20% (p = 0.0047).

- **Phase 1 trial of oral NMNH-Ca demonstrates safety and durable NAD elevation** — *medRxiv* [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.11.26360226)
  - A randomized, double-blind Phase 1 trial evaluated oral reduced nicotinamide mononucleotide calcium salt (NMNH-Ca at 125, 250, and 500 mg daily for 90 days) in 80 healthy adults aged 40–65.
  - NMNH-Ca was well tolerated across all doses with no serious adverse events; single doses peaked whole-blood NAD levels at 12 hours, with sustained NAD elevation observed over 90 days.

- **First-in-human trial validates onboard accelerometer-guided adaptive DBS in Parkinson's disease** — *medRxiv* [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.10.26360135)
  - Investigators implemented real-time closed-loop deep brain stimulation using an onboard triaxial accelerometer inside the Picostim DyNeuMo-2c device to classify gait states and trigger automated program adjustments in a Parkinson's patient.
  - The gait-adaptive protocol improved objective walking parameters compared to traditional open-loop stimulation optimized for resting tremor.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

- **[Biotech]** **Definium Therapeutics and BioXcel report positive Phase 3 VOYAGE data for oral LSD DT120 in GAD** — *STAT News, BioPharma Dive, BioStocks / X* [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/12/definium-lsd-treatment-anxiety-study/) [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/definium-lsd-psychedelics-trial-results-gad-anxiety/827669/) [BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2087494535597199642)
  - Pharmaceutical-grade LSD orally disintegrating tablet (DT120 ODT) met its primary and key secondary efficacy endpoints in the Phase 3 VOYAGE study for generalized anxiety disorder (GAD).
  - The treatment achieved statistically significant reductions in anxiety scores on a standard 56-point scale, marking the first of two pivotal Phase 3 trials in GAD following earlier positive readouts in major depressive disorder.

- **[Biotech]** **Cullinan Therapeutics hits PFS endpoint in Phase 3 REZILIENT-3 trial of zipalertinib** — *BioStocks / X* [BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2087685864914616395)
  - Planned interim analysis of the Phase 3 REZILIENT-3 trial showed zipalertinib plus chemotherapy met its primary endpoint of progression-free survival (PFS).
  - The study evaluates the therapy in first-line EGFR exon 20 insertion mutation non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

- **[Big Pharma]** **Phase 3 LITESPARK-011 trial evaluates belzutifan plus lenvatinib in renal cell carcinoma** — *PubMed* [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42586114/)
  - The randomized Phase 3 LITESPARK-011 study compared the HIF-2α inhibitor belzutifan in combination with lenvatinib against cabozantinib monotherapy in patients with previously treated advanced renal cell carcinoma.

- **[Big Pharma]** **ARANOTE Phase 3 trial details darolutamide benefit across mHSPC subgroups** — *PubMed* [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42586872/)
  - Prespecified subgroup analyses from the Phase 3 ARANOTE trial showed consistent efficacy for darolutamide plus androgen-deprivation therapy (ADT) across disease volume and risk categories in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer.

- **DRC and WHO advance plans for multi-arm Phase 3 Ebola vaccine trial** — *STAT News* [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/12/ebola-who-drc-ebola-vaccine-trial/)
  - The Democratic Republic of the Congo and the World Health Organization are in advanced talks to expedite a multi-arm Phase 3 trial testing several Ebola vaccine candidates.

## Regulatory & Approvals

- **[Biotech]** **Safety concerns raised following deaths tied to newly approved Prader-Willi drug Vykat** — *STAT News* [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/12/neurocrine-biosciences-vykat-prader-willi/)
  - Neurocrine Biosciences' recently approved drug Vykat for Prader-Willi syndrome is under scrutiny after clinical experts linked treatment to a series of patient deaths.

- **[Biotech]** **Unicycive Therapeutics prepares oxylanthanum carbonate NDA resubmission pending vendor inspection** — *BioStocks / X* [BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2087511014459748445)
  - FDA assigned a third-party manufacturing vendor inspection for oxylanthanum carbonate (OLC).
  - Unicycive plans to resubmit its NDA following a successful inspection; cash reserves stood at $61.4M.

- **FDA grants approval for novel oncolytic virus therapy** — *Nature Reviews Drug Discovery* [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00136-z)
  - The US FDA has approved a novel oncolytic virus therapeutic modality for clinical use.

- **FDA finalizes PDUFA formal meeting guidance for drug sponsors** — *U.S. FDA* [U.S. FDA](http://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/formal-meetings-between-fda-and-sponsors-or-applicants-pdufa-products)
  - Final guidance outlines administrative recommendations for industry regarding formal meeting requests and conduct with CDER and CBER.
  - Replaces draft guidance released in September 2023 for human drug and biological product applications.

- **FDA issues second 21st Century Cures Act report on patient experience data** — *U.S. FDA* [U.S. FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/development-approval-process-drugs/assessment-use-patient-experience-data-regulatory-decision-making)
  - Regulatory report prepared by Booz Allen Hamilton assesses how patient experience data and Patient-Focused Drug Development (PFDD) tools were utilized in NDA, BLA, and efficacy supplement decisions.
  - Combines document reviews and agency staff interviews under Section 3004 requirements.

- **FDA updates reference directory of pharmacogenomic biomarkers in drug labeling** — *U.S. FDA* [U.S. FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/science-and-research-drugs/table-pharmacogenomic-biomarkers-drug-labeling)
  - Resource maintains updated therapeutic product listings from Drugs@FDA containing labeling guidance on pharmacogenomic markers, exposure variability, adverse event risks, and genotype-specific dosing.

## Business & Strategy

- **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly files six lawsuits targeting illicit sales of experimental retatrutide** — *BioPharma Dive, BioStocks / X* [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/lilly-lawsuit-retatrutide-black-market-obesity-drug/827659/) [BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2087480723510870470)
  - Eli Lilly filed six lawsuits against compounding centers, online sellers, foreign entities, and unauthorized distributors selling unregulated versions of its experimental triple GIP/GLP-1/glucagon agonist retatrutide.
  - Lilly emphasized that retatrutide remains investigational, with formal FDA filing planned for next year following ongoing Phase 3 trials.

- **[Big Pharma]** **[Biotech]** **Gilead exercises $10M option for second MacroGenics bispecific program** — *Jacob Plieth / X* [Jacob Plieth / X](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2087469816651088240)
  - Gilead Sciences exercised a $10M option to acquire rights to a second T-cell engager candidate developed by MacroGenics.

- **[Biotech]** **Boulevard Bio launches with $65M to advance bispecific antibodies in autoimmune disease** — *BioPharma Dive, STAT News* [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/boulevard-immune-drugs-igan-georg-schett/827583/) [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/12/boulevard-bio-georg-schett-antibody-therapies/)
  - Co-founded by researcher Georg Schett, Boulevard Bio debuted with $65 million in funding and three antibody programs.
  - Lead Phase 1 asset BLVD-101 is a bispecific antibody targeting BAFF and APRIL designed for 12-week dosing in IgA nephropathy, aiming to reduce injection frequency relative to existing therapies.

- **[Biotech]** **Cardiff Oncology and Nerviano enter litigation over onvansertib ownership** — *Jacob Plieth / X* [Jacob Plieth / X](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2087476099970191696)
  - Cardiff Oncology and Nerviano Medical Sciences filed cross-lawsuits over rights to PLK1 inhibitor onvansertib.
  - Cardiff maintains plans to initiate a Phase 3 trial despite the pending legal action and financing needs.

- **[Biotech]** **Liquidia reports $170.4M in Q2 Yutrepia sales** — *BioStocks / X* [BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2087487956332294256) [BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2087488764868256183)
  - Recorded Q2 net product sales of $170.4M for Yutrepia (treprostinil) inhalation powder and net income of $74.7M, representing four consecutive quarters of increasing profitability.
  - Generated more than 5,900 unique patient prescriptions since its June 2025 launch, bringing total cash reserves to $284.2M.

## Public Health & Policy

- **White House executive order revising childhood vaccine schedule draws global pushback** — *Science-Based Medicine, STAT News, BioPharma Dive* [Science-Based Medicine](http://sciencebasedmedicine.org/trumps-frontal-assault-on-vaccines/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=trumps-frontal-assault-on-vaccines) [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/12/trump-vaccine-executive-order-critiqued-by-tedros-who/) [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/silence-divesiran-vaccines-itm-crl-abcellera-biomarin/827400/)
  - An executive order issued by President Trump directs HHS to cut recommended childhood vaccines from 17 to 11 and unbundle the combination MMR vaccine into separate shots.
  - WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the plan increases administration burdens and disease vulnerability, while health authorities including the UK MHRA reiterated commitment to established multi-disease childhood immunization regimens.

- **US administration updates addiction guidance to emphasize faith and abstinence** — *STAT News* [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/12/addiction-homelessness-hhs-toolkit-harm-reduction/)
  - New White House policy guidance shifts federal addiction frameworks toward abstinence and faith-based treatment models while scaling back support for public health harm-reduction strategies.

- **Predictive spatial modeling framework deployed for DRC Bundibugyo virus outbreak** — *medRxiv* [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.12.26360244)
  - A Bayesian discrete-time hazard model integrating an incidence-weighted force-of-infection parameter was evaluated across 106 health zones to predict spatial viral spread and optimize resource allocation during the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the DRC.

**Worth watching:** Post-marketing safety scrutiny surrounding Neurocrine's Vykat, regulatory progress for Unicycive's OLC pending vendor inspection, and upcoming Phase 3 TNBC trial initiations for ivonescimab.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [40 grams drops Visceral Fat](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/BhOSpwKem-4) -- Physionic
        - Multiple randomized controlled trials indicate that resistant starch supplementation helps reduce visceral fat stored around internal organs, with changes visible on MRI.
        - Clinical trials showing positive outcomes typically administered 40 grams of actual resistant starch per day, distinct from 40 grams of total powder which often contains lower percentage concentrations.
        - Natural dietary sources like green bananas and plantains contain resistant starch but generally fail to deliver the high doses evaluated in the strongest clinical trials.
    - [The Reason AI Still Needs Humans](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/nNXuQnoCU7s) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - George Mathew discusses the necessity of human-in-the-loop artificial intelligence architectures within healthcare settings.
        - The presentation addresses issues surrounding medical liability and legal accountability when deploying healthcare AI.
        - It explains why digital health and AI companies are currently unprepared to replace human clinicians with automated systems.
- Pure Science
    - [7+ théories de la conscience - Passe-science #70](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TY253JSe1Wg) -- Passe-Science
        - The video reviews current scientific approaches to phenomenal consciousness—the subjective experience of perceiving reality—focusing on theories within computational functionalism.
        - It surveys computational and representational frameworks, including Higher-Order Theory, Self-Representational Theory, Attention Schema Theory, Recurrent Processing Theory, Sensorimotor Contingency Theory, and Global Workspace Theory.
        - It examines Predictive Processing / Active Inference, Integrated Information Theory (IIT), and the Unfolding Argument regarding feedforward equivalence and causal structure theories.
